summary.text: Betsy Coffia is the Democratic state representative for Michigan House District 103, which she has held since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as a newspaper reporter and editor and a Head Start social worker.

paragraphs.text: Betsy Coffia earned an associate degree from Northwestern Michigan College and a bachelor's degree in social work from Ferris State University.
Her career has included work as a newspaper reporter, a weekly newspaper editor, and a social worker with Head Start.
She has been affiliated with the Grand Traverse Economic Development Corporation, Grand Traverse Leelanau Veterans Affairs and the Traverse Heights Neighborhood Association.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Coffia described herself as a Grand Traverse County commissioner who in 2018 flipped a seat held by a multi-term Republican incumbent.
She said she grew up in a working-class family in Kalkaska County and worked three jobs to put herself through college.
She took office in the state House on January 1, 2023, succeeding Daire Rendon.
